# spatial-structures.types: Bvh2D

**Status:** Supported (tier `geometry`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> A binary bounding volume hierarchy
> (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bounding\_volume\_hierarchy) over 2D
> primitives. Node 0 is the root; PrimitiveIndices is the leaf-order
> permutation of the caller's primitive list. No builder yet: instances come
> from a host, until BuildBvh (spatial-structures.library.plato) gains a 2D
> twin — see tracker/decisions/2026-08-04-spatial-structure-construction-in-plato.md.
